name: Waxseal
author: E. T. Carter
description: A wax seal pressed onto aged parchment under warm raking light. The sheet fills the frame with laid fibres, pulp mottle and soft wrinkles, stained brown only at its borders so the left of the page stays clear; right of centre a squeezed wax disc with a rim bead and a drip lobe carries a raised faceted compass rose inside a beaded ring, with two ribbon tails running out beneath it. The light sweeps a shallow arc so the gloss walks across the mark and the facets trade brightness.

params.label: Seal size
params.effect: Radius of the wax disc in CSS pixels; small leaves a stamp in the corner of a wide sheet, large fills the right of the frame.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Depth of the die impression and the raised mark; 0 is a smooth blank blob of wax, 2 is a deeply cut crest.

params.label: Light sweep
params.effect: Speed of the raking light swinging through its arc; 0 holds the light still so only the candle level breathes.

params.label: Age
params.effect: Brown border staining and foxing on the sheet; 0 is fresh cream stock, 1 a page browned to the frame edge.

params.label: Gloss
params.effect: Wax specular strength; 0 is matte sealing wax, 2 is freshly poured and still shiny.
